about: Named brand colours: a palette's optional "names", keyed by the colour as #RRGGBB in upper case, each at most 40 characters, left out when empty. `kit` reads and writes back as it is; `names` are what each colour reads as — `name` its brand name (null for none), `spoken` as a swatch says it: the brand name, else its hue's with a capital; `rename` rows each start from `kit`, call the palette's colour by the name given (null or blank takes it away) and give the palette's names after; `swap` rows are what Change all and Colours in selection say for a swap; `describe` rows give a guidelines swatch's first line for a colour called `name` — kept as typed, its stars no style markers — or its hue's for none; `gone` rows each start from `kit`, take palette 0's colour `remove` out (if given), then add each of `add` to palette 0 in turn (newest first, at most 12 kept), and give palette 0's names after and the name `probe` reads by then (null for none) — a colour no longer in the palette has no name, even when added back. Shared row for row by both phones' tests (Android BrandColourNamesTest, iOS BrandColourNamesTests).
